<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://algomation.io/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_main" isExecutable="false" name="Invoice-to-Pay">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Invoice
Received"><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Register" name="Register
Invoice"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Match" name="3-Way
Match"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Match" name="Match OK?"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Dispute" name="Raise
Dispute"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Approve" name="Manager

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_Approved" name="Approved?"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Pay" name="Schedule
Payment"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Reject" name="Notify
Supplier"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Payment
Scheduled"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Invoice
Rejected"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Register"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Register" targetRef="Task_Match"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Match" targetRef="GW_Match"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Match" targetRef="Task_Approve"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Match" targetRef="Task_Dispute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Dispute" targetRef="Task_Approve"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Approve" targetRef="GW_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="Yes" sourceRef="GW_Approved" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="No" sourceRef="GW_Approved" targetRef="Task_Reject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_Reject" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="Process_main">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Start_di" bpmnElement="Start"><dc:Bounds x="152" y="82" width="36" height="36"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="140" y="125" width="60" height="27"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_Match_di" bpmnElement="Task_Match"><dc:Bounds x="390" y="60" width="100" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GW_Match_di" bpmnElement="GW_Match" isMarkerVisible="true"><dc:Bounds x="545" y="75" width="50" height="50"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="528" y="132" width="55" height="14"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_Dispute_di" bpmnElement="Task_Dispute"><dc:Bounds x="630" y="170" width="100" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_Approve_di" bpmnElement="Task_Approve"><dc:Bounds x="650" y="60" width="100" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GW_Approved_di" bpmnElement="GW_Approved" isMarkerVisible="true"><dc:Bounds x="805" y="75" width="50" height="50"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="788" y="132" width="55" height="14"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_Pay_di" bpmnElement="Task_Pay"><dc:Bounds x="910" y="60" width="100" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_Reject_di" bpmnElement="Task_Reject"><dc:Bounds x="910" y="170" width="100" height="80"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="End_Paid_di" bpmnElement="End_Paid"><dc:Bounds x="1062" y="82" width="36" height="36"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="1048" y="125" width="64" height="27"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="End_Rejected_di" bpmnElement="End_Rejected"><dc:Bounds x="1062" y="192" width="36" height="36"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="1045" y="235" width="70" height="27"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_1_di" bpmnElement="Flow_1"><di:waypoint x="188" y="100"/><di:waypoint x="240" y="100"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_2_di" bpmnElement="Flow_2"><di:waypoint x="340" y="100"/><di:waypoint x="390" y="100"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_3_di" bpmnElement="Flow_3"><di:waypoint x="490" y="100"/><di:waypoint x="545" y="100"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_4_di" bpmnElement="Flow_4"><di:waypoint x="595" y="100"/><di:waypoint x="650" y="100"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="614" y="82" width="18" height="14"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_5_di" bpmnElement="Flow_5"><di:waypoint x="570" y="125"/><di:waypoint x="570" y="210"/><di:waypoint x="630" y="210"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="576" y="163" width="15" height="14"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_7_di" bpmnElement="Flow_7"><di:waypoint x="750" y="100"/><di:waypoint x="805" y="100"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_8_di" bpmnElement="Flow_8"><di:waypoint x="855" y="100"/><di:waypoint x="910" y="100"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="874" y="82" width="18" height="14"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_9_di" bpmnElement="Flow_9"><di:waypoint x="830" y="125"/><di:waypoint x="830" y="210"/><di:waypoint x="910" y="210"/><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="836" y="163" width="15" height="14"/></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_11_di" bpmnElement="Flow_11"><di:waypoint x="1010" y="210"/><di:waypoint x="1062" y="210"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
dmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" xmlns:dmndi="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/DMNDI/" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20180521/DC/" id="definitions" name="Invoice Approval" namespace="http://algomation.io/dmn">
  <decision id="Decision_main" name="Approval Required">
    <decisionTable id="dt_1" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="In_amt" label="Invoice Amount EUR"><inputExpression id="IE_amt" typeRef="number"><text>amount</text></inputExpression></input>
      <input id="In_vendor" label="Vendor Status"><inputExpression id="IE_vendor" typeRef="string"><text>vendorStatus</text></inputExpression></input>
      <output id="Out_level" label="Approval Level" name="approvalLevel" typeRef="string"/>
      <output id="Out_auto" label="Auto-Approve" name="autoApprove" typeRef="boolean"/>
      <rule id="R1"><inputEntry id="R1i1"><text><= 500</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R1i2"><text>"trusted"</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R1o1"><text>"None"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R1o2"><text>true</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R2"><inputEntry id="R2i1"><text><= 5000</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R2i2"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R2o1"><text>"Manager"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R2o2"><text>false</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R3"><inputEntry id="R3i1"><text>[5001..50000]</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R3i2"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R3o1"><text>"Director"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R3o2"><text>false</text></outputEntry></rule>
      <rule id="R4"><inputEntry id="R4i1"><text>> 50000</text></inputEntry><inputEntry id="R4i2"><text>-</text></inputEntry><outputEntry id="R4o1"><text>"CFO"</text></outputEntry><outputEntry id="R4o2"><text>false</text></outputEntry></rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>
cmmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/CMMN/20151109/MODEL" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://algomation.io/cmmn">
  <case id="Case_main" name="Invoice Exception Case">
    <casePlanModel id="CasePlanModel_1" name="Exception Handling" autoComplete="false">
      <planItem id="PI_S1" definitionRef="Stage_Dispute"/>
      <planItem id="PI_S2" definitionRef="Stage_Escalation"/>
      <stage id="Stage_Dispute" name="Dispute Resolution">
        <planItem id="PI_T1" definitionRef="HT_1"/>
        <planItem id="PI_T2" definitionRef="HT_2"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_1" name="Contact Vendor"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_2" name="Review PO"/>
      </stage>
      <stage id="Stage_Escalation" name="Escalation">
        <planItem id="PI_T3" definitionRef="HT_3"/>
        <planItem id="PI_T4" definitionRef="HT_4"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_3" name="CFO Review"/>
        <humanTask id="HT_4" name="Legal Assessment"/>
      </stage>
    </casePlanModel>
  </case>
</definitions>
